{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Core Planning System — 13 Templates + LLM Fallback + Macro/Phases","content":"The Planner class in src/core/planner.ts (776 lines) decomposes goals into subtasks. It has 13 DecompositionRule templates: add/create, fix/bug, refactor, test, deploy, migrate, doc, perf, security, docker, ci/cd, research, and generic create. Template selection uses scoring: pattern match (2pt) + keyword match (1pt) + keyword density (0.5pt/kw) + domain bonus (1pt). Falls back to decomposeWithLLM() for arbitrary goals. Also supports hierarchical Macro/Micro phase planning via decomposeMacro() with 4 MacroTemplates (create, fix, refactor, research). Has PlannerCritic self-reflection loop for plan quality and TreeSearchPlanner with beam search (BEAM_WIDTH=3, MAX_DEPTH=4). Cycle detection uses Kahn's algorithm on a DependencyGraph.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"LLM Engine — OpenCode SDK Integration with Semantic Cache + Model Resolution","content":"The LLMEngine class in src/core/llm.ts (1208 lines) is the single path for all LLM calls via OpenCode SDK (no direct external API calls). Features: exact-match cache (30s TTL, 1000 entries), Gap #7 semantic cache (TF-IDF + cosine similarity, threshold 0.7), multi-provider auto-fallback chain, cost-aware auto-switch, model resolution by tool→category→explicit override. Method call() is the main entry: resolves model, checks semantic cache, then exact-match cache, calls callOpenCode() via SDK session.prompt(), on failure tries fallback chain, then session default. After success records tokens to BudgetTracker and emits llm.response event. Also has chat mode with temp session for multi-turn conversations.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"3-Layer Graph Harness — Agent Loop with DAG Execution + Recovery Escalation","content":"The AgentLoop in src/core/agent-loop.ts (819 lines) implements the 3-layer Graph Harness architecture (arXiv:2604.11378). PlanningLayer (SS3.1) creates and versions DAG plans. ExecutionLayer (SS3.2) executes DAG nodes with parallel phases using Kahn's topological sort, concurrency limit of 4, loop detection (rolling 60s window, max 5 identical calls), and circuit breaker. RecoveryLayer (SS3.3) implements strict escalation: retry (per-node backoff: linear=min(attempt*1000,30s) or exponential=min(2^attempt*500,30s)) → replan (creates new plan version v2+, preserving v1 immutable) → escalate (permanent failure). Intermediate verify failures are NON-BLOCKING (warn only). Final step verification is BLOCKING. DAGEngine (src/core/dag-engine.ts, 738 lines) handles the actual node execution with phase-based parallel pools.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Multi-Dimensional Verifier — 3-Tier Security/Performance/Architecture/Deps Checks","content":"The Verifier class in src/core/verifier.ts (786 lines) provides multi-dimensional verification with 3 tiers: fast (compile-only with caching), standard (compile + lint + test + domain verifiers + semantic LLM check), deep (standard + security + performance + architecture + deps). Security checks OWASP Top 10 via LLM (SQLi, XSS, RCE, path traversal, hardcoded secrets). Performance detects N+1 queries, O(n^2) loops, memory leaks. Architecture analyzes import graph for circular dependencies and layer violations. Deps runs npm audit / pip audit / cargo audit. Supports 6 languages (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, unknown) with auto-detection from project files. Each deep check dimension can be independently toggled via DeepVerificationConfig.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Multi-Agent System — Coordinator, Orchestrator, Role Registry, A2A Protocol","content":"The agents/ layer has 7 files. Coordinator (src/agents/coordinator.ts) handles task delegation to specialist roles (architect, developer, qa, coordinator, pm), auto-suggests role via LLM→keyword fallback, maintains shared memory with async mutex, and supports 6 inter-agent message types. Orchestrator (src/agents/orchestrator.ts) defines multi-agent workflow pipelines with formal contracts (PipelineContract with I/O schemas, pre/post-conditions, cross-stage invariants). Has 4 built-in pipelines: feature-dev (PM→Arch→Dev→QA), fix-verify, refactor-review, deploy-check. RoleRegistry (src/agents/role-registry.ts) manages 9 built-in roles + custom roles, versioned prompt history with rollback support. A2A protocol (a2a-server.ts, a2a-client.ts, a2a-types.ts) implements Google A2A standard for cross-framework agent discovery and task delegation via HTTP JSON-RPC.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Memory System — Episodic Store, Skill Store, RAG, Vector Store, Session Store","content":"The memory/ layer has 13 files providing comprehensive cross-session persistence. EpisodicStore (episodic-store.ts) records task episodes with TF-IDF search, project-scoped isolation, schema versioning, and decay/forgetting. SkillStore (skill-store.ts) extracts and stores reusable skills with self-describing agentic-skill/v1 schema (skill-format.ts), sliding window success rate tracking (20-window), and TF-IDF search. MultiIndexRAG (multi-index-rag.ts) provides category-segregated hybrid search (TF-IDF + optional vector embedding) across 5 default categories (automotive, financial, personal, tech, general) plus dynamic categories. VectorStore (vector-store.ts) is a zero-dependency TF-IDF inverted index with unigram+bigram tokenization, title/keyword match bonuses, and length normalization. LocalEmbedder (local-embedder.ts) provides text embedding via OpenAI-compatible API or hash-based fallback. SessionStore (session-store.ts) maintains in-memory conversation state with 30-second auto-persist.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Executor & Execution State — Step Tracking, Error Categories, Retry Logic","content":"The Executor class in src/core/executor.ts (344 lines) manages plan execution state per session. It tracks completed/failed steps, retry counts, and dependency resolution. Key methods: getNextStep() returns first pending step with met deps, getReadySteps() returns all executable steps, getBlockedSteps() shows waiting steps with their blockers, recordResult() records step outcome with auto error category detection (import/type/compile/test/runtime/unknown). Per-category maxRetries: import=3, type=2, compile=2, test=1, runtime=1, unknown=1, error=2. canRetry() checks retry count against per-category limits. replanStep() replaces failed step with multiple new subtasks, renumbering duplicates. ErrorAnalyzer (error-analyzer.ts, 129 lines) uses domain-specific ErrorMatcher patterns first, then regex fallback, then LLM for unknown categories. Auto-retry (auto-retry.ts) uses strategy rotation (direct_fix → conservative → type_first → split_changes) with exponential backoff and full jitter.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Budget Tracker — Circuit Breaker with Token/Step/Time/Cost Limits","content":"The BudgetTracker class in src/core/budget-tracker.ts (428 lines) implements a resource circuit breaker pattern (PDP/PEP) with 4 metrics: tokens (input+output+cache+reasoning), steps (subtask count), time (wall-clock minus approval pauses), cost (derived from token × model prices). Two scopes: session and task. OnExceededBehavior: hard-stop (throw), request-approval (return event), warn (only log). Uses per-model price ledger with defaults for common models (gpt-4o: $2.50/$10, gpt-4o-mini: $0.15/$0.60, claude-sonnet-4: $3/$15, deepseek-v4-flash-free: $0/$0). Syncs with OpenCode SDK via syncFromOpenCode() for accurate cost tracking. PEP check is synchronous (check-based). Used as circuit breaker in DAGEngine and AgentLoop.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Drift Layer — Hallucination Guard, Checkpoints, Dependency Tracking, Context Compression","content":"The drift/ layer has 5 files for error detection and recovery. HallucinationGuard (hallucination-guard.ts) verifies 4 claim types: file_exists, function_exists, import_valid, api_signature. Uses path traversal protection (resolveSafe) and multi-language function detection (TS/JS, Python, Go, Rust). CheckpointSystem (checkpoints.ts) provides 3 risk types: WARNING (informational), REVIEW (request review), BLOCK (halt execution). Detects file deletion, mass changes, API changes, config/secret exposure, test-only changes. DependencyTracker (dependency-tracker.ts) tracks per-session file changes and builds import graphs from ESM/CommonJS/dynamic imports. errorPropagationAnalysis() traverses transitive dependents to find error roots. ContextCompressor (context-compressor.ts) uses rule-based extraction (decisions, fileChanges, invariants) with LLM compression fallback when context exceeds threshold. PatternDiscovery (pattern-discovery.ts) analyzes cross-session error patterns with trend computation (first-half vs second-half success rate).","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Model Registry — Per-Model Reliability, Quarantine, Task-Type Scoring","content":"The ModelRegistry class in src/core/model-registry.ts (475 lines) tracks per-model reliability statistics. Each recordCall() updates total/success/failed counters, running avg latency, cost tracking, and per-task-type breakdowns. Auto-quarantines after 5 consecutive failures (quarantineUntil = now + 30min). Auto-releases after 3 consecutive successes with min 5 calls and hallucination < 0.2. Scoring: reliability = max(0, successRate - hallucinationRate * 2). Status thresholds: healthy vs degraded (3+ consecutive failures) vs unstable (hallucination > 30% or success < 40%). selectBestModel() uses multi-factor scoring: 40% user satisfaction, 35% reliability, 25% cost inverse. Supports aliases (fast/capable) and task-type-specific scoring. isBlocked() returns hard block (quarantine/reliability < 0.2/5+ consecutive failures/hallucination > 50%) or soft block.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Domain System — 6 Built-In Domain Packs with Verifiers and Error Matchers","content":"The DomainRegistry (domain-registry.ts) manages domain-specific behavior. Each DomainPack contains: detect() function (score 0-1), verifier strategies, error matchers, decomposition rules, file extensions, tools, skills, roles, and formal contracts. 6 built-in domains: generic (fallback — semantic-only verification), code (general SE — TS/JS/Python/Rust/Go language detection), security (OWASP vulnerability scanning), devops (Docker/K8s/Terraform file verification), data-science (ML/DS — PyTorch/TensorFlow/scikit-learn pipeline validation), mobile (Android/iOS/Flutter/RN project detection). Domain auto-detected via activateFor() by scoring all packs' detect() against input. Current domain's verifiers and error matchers are used for verification and error analysis.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Event System — Pub/Sub EventBus with 9 Namespaces and Live Evaluation","content":"The EventBus (event-bus.ts) provides pub/sub event system with 9 namespaces: step.*, plan.*, pipeline.*, budget.*, guard.*, task.*, llm.*, file.*, memory.*. Methods: on(type, handler) for specific events, onAny(handler) for wildcard, emit(event) to dispatch. The event-taxonomy.ts defines typed event schemas. Key subscribers in index.ts: LiveEvaluator tracks step outcomes for real-time 5-dimension scoring (taskSuccess 40%, errorRecovery 20%, contextStability 15%, multiAgent 15%, skillReuse 10%). ContinuousEvolution feeds step results for auto-evolution triggering. TraceLogger logs all events to JSONL. Orchestrator auto-advances pipeline stages. ModelRegistry records hallucination guard failures.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Prompt System — Knowledge-First Architecture with Auto-Injected RAG Context","content":"The prompt system implements Knowledge-First Architecture (2026). PromptTemplate (prompt-template.ts, 252 lines) builds XML-structured prompts: <identity> (who the agent is), <knowledge-context> (external knowledge from RAG/web/arXiv, framed as REFERENCE DATA per OWASP), <instructions> (what to do with tools and workflow), <guardrails> (constraints and anti-hallucination rules). KnowledgeEntry interface: source URL, confidence 0-1, content, category. Knowledge is auto-injected into every LLM call via the system.transform hook. If RAG confidence < 0.6 or empty, LLM MUST call webfetch before working. PromptBuilder (prompt-builder.ts) builds dynamic prompts per active domain with tool lists, active tools filtered by domain, research-first workflow instructions, and category-specific guardrails.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Self-Evolution System — Skill Patching, Role Suggestion, Prompt Improvement","content":"The evolution/ layer has 2 files. SelfEvolver (self-evolver.ts) analyzes skills with < 80% success rate and generates patches (add_rollback, add_step, add_verify, add_guard, tighten_i_o, add_fallback). Also suggests new agent roles from failure patterns and generates prompt patches mapped from error categories to role-specific instructions. ContinuousEvolution (continuous-evolution.ts) monitors rolling 30-step window for degrading/improving/stable performance. Features Gap #12 predictive degradation with bucket-based trend analysis + exponential smoothing for forecasting future success rate. Week-over-week seasonality detection. Hysteresis: 2-minute cooldown + min 10 data points before triggering auto-evolution. Auto-evolution triggered on every step completion/failure.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Observability — Dashboard + Trace Logger + Structured Logger","content":"The observability/ layer has 3 files. Dashboard (dashboard.ts) provides timeline visualization, 4 anomaly types (timeout >30s, retry_storm 3+ failures, loop same in 5 steps, silent_failure), latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), peak concurrency (interval-based overlap detection), and model reliability statistics. TraceLogger (trace-logger.ts) writes JSONL trace files with buffering (10 entries), 5-second auto-flush, dedup guard (prevents consecutive identical entries), and 7-day retention pruning. Logger (logger.ts) provides structured logging with severity levels, source tagging, and JSON mode for machine parsing. All tool calls are logged via eventBus.onAny, and traces are also indexed into the RAG vector store for semantic search.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Code Sandbox — Safe Code Execution with Banned Token Checks and VM Sandbox","content":"The CodeSandbox (code-sandbox.ts, 593 lines) provides safe code generation using Node.js vm module. Features: 15 banned token patterns (require, import(), process, fs, eval, child_process, fetch, WebSocket, etc.), sandboxed VM context with whitelisted globals (no fs/process/network), test runner with deep equality checking, and a CodeModuleRegistry for managing generated code modules. The execute() method: checks banned tokens, creates VM context, compiles vm.Script, runs with timeout. The runTests() method runs multiple test cases with deep equality. The processCode() method is the full pipeline: banned check → execute → test → register module. Supports multiple languages for static validation (TS/JS/Python/Go/Rust).","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Navigator — Multi-Language Codebase Scanner with Relevance Scoring","content":"The CodebaseNavigator (navigator.ts) scans project codebases for task-relevant files. Supports 7 languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, plus generic fallback. Each language has its own LanguageConfig with file extensions, comment syntax, and import/export patterns. Indexes files using relevance scoring: keyword match in filename (5pt) > import/export (4pt) > class/function definition (3pt) > variable/comment (2pt) > content (1pt). Builds a ProjectIndex with ModuleInfo per file (imports, exports, classes, functions, variables, comment). Shows module-level dependency graph. Results ranked by combined relevance score, with configurable max results.","type":"episode"}

{"action":"store","category":"tech","title":"Config System — .agentic/config.json with Hot-Reload Support","content":"The ConfigLoader (config.ts, 497 lines) manages plugin configuration. Loads/saves .agentic/config.json with JSON Schema validation (type, range, enum checks). Auto-creates default config on first load. Features hot-reload via fs.watch with 5-second polling fallback. onChange() listeners updated when config changes on disk. Config sections: memory (enabled/mode/maxEntries/forgetAfterDays/search weights), agent (maxDelegationDepth/autoSkillExtract/autoHallucinationCheck/hallucinationThreshold/hardBlockReliability/softBlockReliability/deepVerification toggles), storage (traceRetentionDays/skillMaxCount), embedding (model/endpoint/apiKey for vector search), fineTuning (apiKey/baseURL/model/trainingEpochs/batchSize). Config propagated to MultiIndexRAG, Coordinator, SessionStore, and TraceLogger on hot-reload.","type":"episode"}

## Available Tools in OpenCode Agentic Engine Plugin (30 tools)

### Stage I — Foundation
1. agentic_plan - Auto-decompose goal into subtasks using templates and LLM fallback with cycle detection.
2. agentic_execute - Mark step as complete with auto-verify, hallucination check, and skill extraction.
3. agentic_reflect - Analyze errors by category (import/type/compile/test/runtime) and trace propagation.
4. agentic_verify - Multi-dimensional verification: compile, lint, test, security, perf, architecture, deps (3-tier).
5. agentic_status - Execution dashboard showing progress, blocked steps, dependency graph, retry history.

### Stage II — Intelligence
6. agentic_nav - Scan codebase for files relevant to a query (multi-language support).
7. agentic_context - View or compress context window preserving key decisions and invariants.
8. agentic_snapshot - Save, list, restore execution checkpoints for risky operations.
9. agentic_pr - Generate or create PR descriptions from plan and step results.
10. agentic_score - Technical debt analysis: coupling, file size, scope, patterns.
11. agentic_model - Set/get/list/clear per-role, per-tool, or per-category model preferences.
12. agentic_model_reset - Reset model reliability/hallucination statistics for recovery.
13. agentic_budget - Circuit breaker capping tokens, steps, time, or cost per session/task.

### Stage III — Orchestration
14. agentic_delegate - Assign task to specialist agent (architect/developer/qa/coordinator/pm) with cross-validation.
15. agentic_pipeline - Define, list, run multi-agent workflow pipelines with cross-stage validation.
16. agentic_message - Inter-agent messaging: send, inbox, conversations, review requests.

{"text":"## Available Tools in OpenCode Agentic Engine Plugin (30 tools)

### Stage I — Foundation
1. agentic_plan - Auto-decompose goal into subtasks using templates and LLM fallback with cycle detection.
2. agentic_execute - Mark step as complete with auto-verify, hallucination check, and skill extraction.
3. agentic_reflect - Analyze errors by category (import/type/compile/test/runtime) and trace propagation.
4. agentic_verify - Multi-dimensional verification: compile, lint, test, security, perf, architecture, deps (3-tier).
5. agentic_status - Execution dashboard showing progress, blocked steps, dependency graph, retry history.

### Stage II — Intelligence
6. agentic_nav - Scan codebase for files relevant to a query (multi-language support).
7. agentic_context - View or compress context window preserving key decisions and invariants.
8. agentic_snapshot - Save, list, restore execution checkpoints for risky operations.
9. agentic_pr - Generate or create PR descriptions from plan and step results.
10. agentic_score - Technical debt analysis: coupling, file size, scope, patterns.
11. agentic_model - Set/get/list/clear per-role, per-tool, or per-category model preferences.
12. agentic_model_reset - Reset model reliability/hallucination statistics for recovery.
13. agentic_budget - Circuit breaker capping tokens, steps, time, or cost per session/task.

### Stage III — Orchestration
14. agentic_delegate - Assign task to specialist agent (architect/developer/qa/coordinator/pm) with cross-validation.
15. agentic_pipeline - Define, list, run multi-agent workflow pipelines with cross-stage validation.
16. agentic_message - Inter-agent messaging: send, inbox, conversations, review requests.
17. agentic_parallel - Analyze dependency graph and execute steps concurrently with conflict detection.
18. agentic_skill - Extract, search, list reusable skills from successful tasks.
19. agentic_episodes - Search cross-session memory for past similar tasks and patterns.
20. agentic_dashboard - Observability: timeline, stats, anomalies, model reliability.
21. agentic_guard - Re-check hallucination claims for files, functions, imports.
22. agentic_finetune - End-to-end fine-tuning pipeline: prepare data, upload, create/monitor job.

### Stage IV — Evolution
23. agentic_evolve - Self-evolution: inspect system, register roles, export skills, manage prompts.

### Stage V — Autonomous
24. agentic_auto - One-call autonomous loop: plan, execute, verify, retry with memory plus skills plus guard.

### Blueprint (Prototype)
25. agentic_debate - Executor versus Critic multi-round debate for thorough analysis.
26. agentic_router - Intent classifier routing input to knowledge category and tools.
27. agentic_clean - Strip debate artifacts and reformat to markdown/json with optional schema validation.
28. agentic_rag - Multi-index RAG with category segregation and hybrid TF-IDF/vector search.
29. agentic_mcp - MCP client to connect, discover, and call external tool servers.
30. agentic_a2a - Google A2A protocol: discover remote agents, delegate tasks, serve Agent Card.","format":"json","schema":"array of {name, description, stage}"}

{"filePath":"/home/runner/opencode-agentic-engine/src/README.md","content":"# opencode-agentic-engine — Source

Plugin OpenCode yang mengimplementasikan agentic software engineering workflow.

## Struktur

| Direktori | Fungsi |
|-----------|--------|
| `core/` | Inti engine: planning, execution, verification, LLM, DSL, planner, domain generators |
| `agents/` | Multi-agent coordination: runtime, orchestrator, coordinator, role registry, A2A |
| `drift/` | Error detection & recovery: checkpoints, hallucination guard, context compression |
| `memory/` | Cross-session & in-session memory: episodic store, RAG, skill store, vector store |
| `evaluation/` | Real-time scoring dari tool hooks (5 dimensi) |
| `evolution/` | Self-evolution: continuous evolution, prompt improvement |
| `observability/` | Logger, dashboard, trace logger |

## Entry Point

`index.ts` — registers 33 tools + 6 hooks. Semua tool pakai prefix `agentic_`.
"}

{"filePath":"/home/runner/opencode-agentic-engine/src/drift/README.md","content":"# drift/ — Error Detection & Recovery

| File | Fungsi |
|------|--------|
| `checkpoints.ts` | Risk evaluation: BLOCK/REVIEW/WARNING. Deteksi file deletion, mass changes, API changes, config/secret exposure |
| `context-compressor.ts` | Sliding window + key info extraction untuk context compression |
| `dependency-tracker.ts` | Per-session file change + error propagation tracking |
| `hallucination-guard.ts` | Verifikasi 4 claim types: file_exists, function_exists, import_valid, api_signature. Path traversal protection |
| `pattern-discovery.ts` | Error pattern discovery dari riwayat error |

## Flow

```
execute step → hallucination guard (auto) → checkpoint risk eval → dependency track → pattern discovery
```
"}

{"filePath":"/home/runner/opencode-agentic-engine/src/evaluation/README.md","content":"# evaluation/ — Live Evaluation

| File | Fungsi |
|------|--------|
| `live-evaluator.ts` | 5-dimensi real-time scoring dari tool hooks |

## Dimensi

| Dimensi | Bobot | Target |
|---------|-------|--------|
| `taskSuccess` | 40% | >80% step success |
| `errorRecovery` | 20% | >70% recovered errors |
| `contextStability` | 15% | >80% focused navigation |
| `multiAgent` | 15% | >90% delegation success |
| `skillReuse` | 10% | >50% skill found |

Skor ditampilkan di dashboard via `agentic_dashboard`.
"}

Via `agentic_evolve` tool: inspect, register-role, export-skill, evolve, manage prompts.

### agentic_db

SQLite database backend.

| Parameter | Tipe | Required | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|----------|-----------|
| `action` | `"query" \| "save" \| "load" \| "list" \| "stats" \| "tables" \| "migrate"` | ✅ | Operasi database |
| `sql` | `string` | ❌ | SQL query (untuk action=query) |
| `namespace` | `string` | ❌ | Namespace (untuk save/load/list) |
| `key` | `string` | ❌ | Key (untuk save/load) |
| `data` | `string` | ❌ | JSON data string (untuk save) |
| `scope` | `string` | ❌ | Scope/projectId |

**Deskripsi**: Query, key-value save/load, list tables, migrate JSON → SQLite. WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY support.

---

### agentic_mcp_server

Start/stop MCP server yang mengekspos plugin tools via standard MCP protocol.

| Parameter | Tipe | Required | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|----------|-----------|
| `action` | `"start" \| "stop" \| "status" \| "restart"` | ✅ | Operasi server |
| `port` | `number` | ❌ | Port (untuk start) |

**Deskripsi**: External MCP clients bisa discover dan call plugin tools. stdio transport.

---

### agentic_tools

Unified tool discovery dan calling across MCP + A2A protocols.

| Parameter | Tipe | Required | Deskripsi |
|-----------|------|----------|-----------|
| `action` | `"search" \| "call" \| "list" \| "stats"` | ✅ | Operasi |
| `query` | `string` | ❌ | Search query |
| `protocol` | `"mcp" \| "a2a"` | ❌ | Protocol hint (untuk call) |
| `source` | `string` | ❌ | Source identifier (MCP server / A2A agent URL) |
| `method` | `string` | ❌ | Tool name atau capability |
| `params` | `string` | ❌ | JSON string parameter |

**Deskripsi**: Auto-route calls ke backend yang tepat. Search across both protocols.
